question: What is the standard Windows keyboard, shortcut key combination for 'Redo'?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Control+Y**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Control+**Y shortcut key used in standard Windows keyboard for "Redo".
 
• The shortcut for the** Undo command is Control****-Z** in most Apple Macintosh applications, and the shortcut for Redo is Control -Shift-Z.
 
• Undo is the opposite of Redo. 
 
• Undo is an **interaction technique used to delete the last alteration made to the text, reverting it to an older state.**
 
• The ability to reverse the process on the computer has been invented many times independently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
